logp.method_description: Log D7.4 values were determined by applying the shake-flask method developed by Kunz et al. [40]. Equal volumes of phosphate-buffered saline solution (PBS) and n-octanol were stirred together for 72 h prior to use to allow saturation of both the phases. For each experiment, 500 µL of PBS, 530 µL of n-octanol, and 30 µL of the complex solution (2 mg of the analysed species dissolved in 200 µL of DMSO) were combined in an Eppendorf tube and stirred for 30 min, follow by centrifugation (5 min, 3000 rpm) to separate the two phases. The UV/Vis absorption of each phase was recorded at 400 nm. Samples were diluted with the corresponding phase prior to measurement in case the absorption was exceeding 1.
